title: Introduction
text: Instead downloading entire datasets can conditionally download specific data elements. functionality achieved using additional arguments fetch_data() function. Currently can use - filter filter dataset using equality constraints specific columns. select select specific set columns downloaded. sort sort resulting dataset based multiple columns. Following example illustrates - returned dataset - Metadata returned dataset ’s one argument passed fetch_data() function, field_type_correction. data fetch process inadvertently treats columns character. default setting field_type_correction = TRUE converts columns back numeric type based accompanying metadata.
code: mean_temp_25 = fetch_data(res_id = "98fe9271-a59d-4834-b05b-fd5ddb94ac01",                         filter = c("annual" = "25"),                         select = c("year", "annual", "jan_feb", "mar_may", "jun_sep", "oct_dec"),                         sort = c("jan_feb" = "asc", "mar_may" = "desc")                         ) knitr::kable(head(mean_temp_25[[1]])) knitr::kable(mean_temp_25[[2]])
